clips.title: The story
paras: High above Dun Morogh, gnome flying machines and dwarven mountaineers hold a remote airfield northeast of Ironforge. Its plateau overlooks jagged crags and the steep descent toward the Wetlands.

High above Dun Morogh's trails, gnome flying machines line open landing strips among the mountain peaks. Dwarven masonry anchors the ridgelines, and mountaineers watch the perimeter. Nearby, engineers tend the machines and inspect their engines in the cold.

The valley around the airfield is contested ground. Frostmane trolls dwell in nearby caves and harass the dwarven sentries. Across frozen waters beneath the peaks, dwarven defenders and Stormpike patrols clash with troll raiders, keeping the outpost on guard.
